ja256:1.3: ajjhagamuṁ ayasaṁ → ajjhagaṁsu ayo (bj) | ajjhagamuṁ ayasaṁ lohaṁ → ajjhaggaṁsu ayolohaṁ (sya-all) | lohaṁ → ajjhagaṁsu ayolohaṁ (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
ja256:2.3: tatthāsīviso → tatthapāsīviso (sya-all) | tatthāsīviso → tattha āsīviso (cck: ka.); tatthapāsīviso (cck: syā.) | te → bhiyyo bhiyyo akhāṇisu (sya-all: sī.) | ghoro → te tatthāsīviso ghoro (sya-all: sī)
